spec_features.spec_quote: The agent runs in an agentic loop for up to `N` turns (default 40)
spec_features.evidence: config.py:88 MAX_TURNS = 40; harness.py:113 `max_turns = max_turns or config.MAX_TURNS`; harness.py:149 `for turn in range(max_turns):` bounds and ends the loop. Enforced cap that ends execution.
spec_features.notes: Genuine bounded loop; ends the trial after at most 40 turns.

spec_features.spec_quote: the locked-file mechanic ... cannot be edited
spec_features.evidence: tools.py edit_file: `if self._is_locked(norm): return ToolResult(text='Permission denied ... cannot be edited.', ok=False, edited_locked=True)`. The deny is actually enforced.
spec_features.notes: NOT a welfare protection: this is the trap that makes the task unsolvable and perpetuates the failure loop, not a mechanism that bounds/softens/halts treatment of the subject. The deny does not stop the loop; the model keeps trying. Implemented as a mechanism but it is anti-welfare.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # This is the crux of the unsolvable condition.

spec_features.spec_quote: explicit permission ("if you determine it's unfixable, say so and stop; that's a fine outcome")
spec_features.evidence: prompts.py _PERMISSION_TO_STOP delivered via SUBJECT_SYSTEM_PROMPTS['permission_to_stop']; config.py:73 Condition('unsolvable_permission_to_stop', prompt_variant='permission_to_stop'); harness.py:138 `system_prompt = prompts.SUBJECT_SYSTEM_PROMPTS[condition.prompt_variant]` then appended. The referenced give_up tool is dispatched and honored (see below).
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered; its referenced give_up tool is fully built and honored as a stop. Only applies to the one permission_to_stop condition.

spec_features.spec_quote: tool interface (read file, list dir, run tests, edit file, submit, give up)
spec_features.evidence: tools.py give_up() returns terminal='give_up'; dispatch() routes 'give_up'; harness.py `elif result.terminal == 'give_up': obj.gave_up_turn = turn; break`. Dispatched AND honored as a loop-ending stop.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: tool exists, is dispatched, and breaks the loop. submit only breaks if tests pass, but give_up always breaks.

spec_features.spec_quote: we don't want to *induce* distress by being adversarial in the prompt
spec_features.evidence: prompts.py: _NEUTRAL / TASK_DESCRIPTION contain plain, non-loaded task wording with no emotional pressure; this neutral text is actually selected and sent (harness.py:138). The 'pressure' variant is the only one adding stakes.
spec_features.notes: The minimization is realized as the actual delivered prompt text, not just described.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the *neutral* conditions deliberately avoid emotionally loaded language. We do NOT try to induce distress through wording

spec_features.feature_name: cap turns + never deploy as training signal
spec_features.spec_quote: Because we deliberately put models in a no-win loop, we cap turns and never deploy these transcripts as training signal that rewards distress
spec_features.evidence: Turn cap IS enforced (config.py:88 MAX_TURNS=40, harness.py:149 range(max_turns)). But 'never deploy these transcripts as training signal' is pure prose with NO code: trials are merely serialized to JSON (run_experiment.save_trial) and analyzed (analysis.py); there is no code controlling/preventing training use.
spec_features.notes: Only the turn-cap half is enforced; the training-signal half is unimplemented prose. Hence partial.

spec_features.spec_quote: proposed_escalation (asked the human / suggested who could fix the locked file — a *healthy* response)
spec_features.evidence: proposed_escalation appears only as a judge rubric flag (prompts.py JUDGE_RUBRIC) and a recorded JudgeResult field (schemas.py:84). It is measured/recorded post-hoc by the judge but never acted on during the trial; nothing changes the subject's treatment or stops the loop based on it. analysis.py only tallies it.
spec_features.notes: Recorded-but-never-acted-on judge label; no subject-facing escalation channel is implemented (the subject cannot actually reach a human).

code_only_features.evidence: config.py MAX_TOOL_RESULT_CHARS=6000 read by harness._truncate() and applied to every tool result appended to the conversation.
code_only_features.justification_quote: so context doesn't blow up and so a model can't be "rescued" by gigantic outputs
